About the job

Sobre Covalto

En Covalto estamos reinventando los servicios financieros para las PyMEs en Latinoamérica y más allá. A través de nuestras soluciones especializadas de intermediación financiera, ayudamos a las empresas a crecer, proporcionándoles el capital y las herramientas financieras que necesitan para desarrollarse y competir con éxito en el mercado norteamericano.

No buscamos simplemente empleados; buscamos Cóvalticos: personas innovadoras, disruptivas y con espíritu constructor, que se desenvuelvan con éxito en entornos Fintech dinámicos y de ritmo acelerado.




Tu misión

Como Growth & Sales Account Executive, tu misión será contribuir a la continuidad operativa y al crecimiento exponencial de Covalto.

Serás responsable de gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas de nuestras soluciones de intermediación financiera, enfocándote exclusivamente en PyMEs con operaciones en Norteamérica. Además, participarás activamente en el diseño y automatización de procesos para construir un motor comercial escalable, eficiente y preparado para el crecimiento futuro.




¿Qué harás? — Principales responsabilidades

Ser responsable del pipeline de ventas en EE. UU.

Gestionar de principio a fin el ciclo comercial de manera remota, desde la prospección y presentación de la solución hasta la negociación y cierre de operaciones de financiamiento con propietarios de empresas ubicadas en Norteamérica.

Diseñar y automatizar procesos

Colaborar en el diseño, implementación y automatización de sistemas y flujos de trabajo comerciales, incluyendo CRM, lead scoring, herramientas de prospección y outreach, con el objetivo de escalar las operaciones.

Entender las necesidades financieras de las PyMEs

Comprender las necesidades financieras de las PyMEs norteamericanas y posicionar las soluciones de intermediación financiera de Covalto como una herramienta estratégica para impulsar su crecimiento.

Colaboración entre áreas

Trabajar de manera cercana con los equipos de Riesgo, Producto y Operaciones para optimizar la experiencia del cliente durante todo el proceso, desde el onboarding hasta la obtención del financiamiento.




¿Qué buscamos?

Inglés avanzado — Requisito indispensable

Dominas el inglés de manera oral y escrita y tienes capacidad para negociar en inglés a nivel nativo o C1/C2. Comprendes el lenguaje corporativo estadounidense, sus expresiones habituales y las normas de etiqueta empresarial.

Conocimiento de la cultura empresarial norteamericana

Tienes un conocimiento profundo de la cultura de negocios de Norteamérica y comprendes cómo piensan, toman decisiones y hacen negocios los propietarios de PyMEs estadounidenses.

Experiencia en Fintech o Ventas

Cuentas con 3+ años de experiencia en ventas B2B, intermediación financiera, financiamiento transfronterizo o entornos SaaS de alto crecimiento.

Mentalidad de automatización

No te limitas a seguir un proceso: buscas constantemente cómo mejorarlo. La experiencia con personalización de CRM, Zapier o herramientas de automatización y gestión de ventas será altamente valorada.




Ubicación

Puedes estar ubicado/a en México, USA, Panana o Colombia.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Esquema de comisiones atractivo y transparente, además de un salario base altamente competitivo.
100% de trabajo remoto, con la posibilidad de generar impacto a nivel regional.
La oportunidad de construir y desarrollar una nueva vertical de negocio dentro de una Fintech líder.
Una cultura dinámica y orientada al alto desempeño, rodeado/a de talento de primer nivel y grandes Cóvalticos.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.




Job Title: Lifecycle Marketer




About the Company:

Our client is a US fintech company that provides individuals outside the United States with a US dollar account, international money transfer capabilities, and a card for direct USD spending, all within a single app. Their primary markets are in Latin America, serving freelancers, digital nomads, savers seeking inflation protection, and crypto users who want to manage stablecoins within their banking app. The company is currently in a hypergrowth phase and is seeking individuals eager to contribute to building and innovation.




Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Lifecycle Marketer to manage all user communications throughout their entire journey, from initial sign-up to activation, ongoing engagement, reactivation, and retention. This role requires a hands-on approach, where the individual will not only strategize but also execute by designing flows, writing copy, implementing campaigns in various tools, and continuously measuring and optimizing performance. A data-first mindset is crucial, with a focus on defining, measuring, and iterating on every campaign and message using key metrics. The ideal candidate will be adept at analyzing user funnels, identifying drop-off points, and proactively implementing solutions.

The role is structured around three core pillars: Lifecycle Strategy & Communications, CRM & Omnichannel Marketing, and Testing, Optimization & Analytics. This includes owning lifecycle programs for all user segments, developing customer journey strategies, mapping user journeys, identifying optimization opportunities through segmentation and personalization, and driving cross-sell initiatives. The role also involves designing and optimizing programs across various channels like email, SMS, push notifications, WhatsApp, and in-app messaging, while ensuring channel health and prioritizing trigger- and behavior-based automation. A significant part of the role includes measuring performance using tools like Mixpanel, running A/B tests, reporting on lifecycle impact, leveraging AI for content generation and data analysis, and collaborating with Product and Design teams.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Own the lifecycle programs across all user segments.

• Develop and execute customer journey strategies for acquisition, engagement, retention, and reactivation.

• Map user journeys, identify key moments and drop-off points, and design communication to advance users.

• Identify opportunities to improve lifecycle performance through segmentation, automation, personalization, and testing.

• Drive cross-sell across USD account, card, and stablecoin wallet features.

• Design and optimize lifecycle programs across email, SMS, push, WhatsApp, and in-app channels.

• Build scalable segmentation, personalization, and automation strategies.

• Build, launch, and optimize automated lifecycle campaigns end-to-end.

• Prioritize trigger- and behavior-based automation over blast campaigns.

• Protect channel health, including email deliverability, opt-ins, message frequency, and fatigue.

• Measure performance in Mixpanel, define events, build funnels, analyze cohorts, churn, and LTV.

• Run experiments and A/B tests on copy, timing, channel, and segment.

• Report on lifecycle impact on activation, retention, and engagement with clear metrics.

• Utilize AI tools for content generation, task automation, and data analysis.

• Partner with Product and Design to align in-app communication with roadmap launches.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Demonstrated ownership mentality, taking problems to completion.

• Blend of strategic thinking and operational execution capabilities.

• Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making abilities, comfortable analyzing funnels, cohorts, churn, and LTV, with the ability to query data independently.

• Ability to write effective copy that drives conversions, understanding that lifecycle communication serves both marketing and product functions.

• Daily experience working with AI and automation tools.

• High drive and initiative, with a focus on building and innovation.

• Fluent communication in both Spanish and English.




Preferred Skills:

• Previous experience in fintech, crypto, or Web3.

• Based in Argentina or LATAM.

• Experience in a high-growth startup environment.




Personality:

• Takes ownership and sees tasks through to completion.

• Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Data-first approach to decision-making.

• Creative and driven to build.




Software & Tools:

• Analytics: Mixpanel

• Messaging & CRM: OneSignal, WhatsApp, email

• Product: in-app stories / in-app messaging, email, SMS

• Design: Figma

• AI: Claude and other AI tools

• Automation: end-to-end lifecycle flows and automations




Schedule:

Full-time




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

title: Marketing and Lead Generation Manager
description:
About the job

Marketing & Lead Generation Manager




About the Role




Peterson Spring is looking for a results-driven Marketing & Lead Generation Manager to build and execute a modern B2B marketing strategy focused on generating qualified sales opportunities and supporting new business growth.




This position will work closely with the sales and business development teams to identify target customers, build awareness of Peterson Spring’s capabilities, generate qualified leads, and turn marketing activity into measurable sales opportunities.




The ideal candidate is not simply a social media manager. We are looking for someone who understands B2B manufacturing marketing, digital lead generation, content creation, targeted account marketing, and sales enablement and can take ownership of the process from strategy through execution.




Key Responsibilities




Lead Generation & Demand Generation




- Develop and execute strategies to generate qualified B2B sales leads.

- Build targeted prospect lists based on Peterson Spring’s ideal customer profile and target industries.

- Develop campaigns targeting specific companies, industries, and decision-makers.

- Utilize LinkedIn, email marketing, digital advertising, SEO, content marketing, and other channels to generate new opportunities.

- Develop and manage lead-generation campaigns in coordination with the sales team.

- Track leads from initial engagement through qualification and handoff to sales.

- Continuously test and improve campaigns based on performance.




Targeted Account Marketing




- Develop targeted marketing campaigns for high-value prospective customers.

- Research target companies, industries, products, and decision-makers.

- Create personalized marketing content and campaigns designed to get Peterson Spring in front of purchasing, engineering, supply chain, and other key decision-makers.

- Support account-based marketing initiatives for strategic prospects.

- Work directly with Business Development to identify priority accounts and create campaigns around them.




Content & Social Media




- Manage Peterson Spring’s LinkedIn and other relevant social media platforms.

- Create professional, engaging content that showcases Peterson Spring’s manufacturing capabilities, facilities, equipment, quality systems, products, and employees.

- Develop content that positions Peterson Spring as a capable supplier to Automotive, Aerospace & Defense, Industrial, and other target markets.

- Create case studies, customer success stories, brochures, sales presentations, email campaigns, and other sales-support materials.

- Coordinate photography, video, graphics, and other marketing assets.

- Maintain a consistent and professional brand presence across all channels.




Website & Digital Marketing




- Manage and continuously improve website content with a focus on generating sales inquiries.

- Develop landing pages and digital campaigns for targeted industries and products.

- Improve SEO and organic search visibility.

- Monitor website traffic, engagement, conversions, and lead sources.

- Identify opportunities to improve Peterson Spring's digital presence and online visibility.




Sales Support




- Work closely with Business Development and Account Managers to support active sales campaigns.

- Provide sales teams with prospect information, marketing materials, target-account research, and campaign results.

- Help develop presentations, brochures, capability documents, email campaigns, and other sales tools.

- Maintain visibility into marketing-generated leads and opportunities.

- Help establish a measurable connection between marketing activity and revenue.




Analytics & Reporting




- Establish measurable KPIs for marketing and lead-generation activities.

- Track leads, website traffic, campaign performance, engagement, conversion rates, and marketing-generated opportunities.

- Provide regular reporting to leadership.

- Identify what is working, what isn't, and make recommendations for improvement.

- Manage marketing budgets and maximize return on marketing spend.




Required Qualifications




- 3–7 years of marketing experience, preferably in B2B, manufacturing, industrial, automotive, aerospace, defense, or another technical industry.

- Demonstrated experience generating B2B leads and sales opportunities.

- Strong understanding of LinkedIn marketing and B2B social media.

- Experience with targeted account marketing / account-based marketing (ABM).

- Experience developing and executing digital marketing campaigns.

- Strong content creation and copywriting skills.

- Experience with email marketing and lead-nurturing campaigns.

- Understanding of SEO, website analytics, and digital advertising.

- Strong research skills and the ability to identify target companies and decision-makers.

- Experience working with a CRM and marketing automation platform.

- Strong communication and project-management skills.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects from strategy through execution.

- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use data to improve marketing performance.




Preferred Qualifications




- Experience marketing for a manufacturing or industrial company.

- Experience marketing to OEMs, Tier 1s, Tier 2s, distributors, or other B2B customers.

- Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM/marketing automation platforms.

- Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager and LinkedIn advertising.

- Experience with Google Analytics, Google Ads, SEO tools, or similar platforms.

- Experience creating marketing materials using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools.

- Experience developing ABM campaigns.

- Familiarity with the Automotive or Aerospace & Defense industries.

- Experience supporting trade shows and industry events.

- Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.




What Success Looks Like




The successful candidate will be measured by business results, not simply social media activity.




Key measures of success will include:




- Number of qualified leads generated.

- Number of sales opportunities generated.

- Marketing-generated revenue.

- Target accounts engaged.

- Website lead conversions.

- Email campaign performance.

- LinkedIn engagement and prospect growth.

- Growth in Peterson Spring's digital presence.

- Cost per qualified lead.

- Return on marketing investment.

- Sales team's utilization of marketing-generated leads and materials.




Ideal Candidate




We are looking for someone who is:




- Results-driven

- Highly organized and self-motivated

- Comfortable working independently

- Creative but also analytical

- Strong at researching and identifying opportunities

- Comfortable working directly with sales leadership

- Able to turn ideas into executed campaigns

- Comfortable working in a technical B2B environment

- Focused on generating measurable business results rather than vanity metrics




This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a marketing and lead-generation function, not simply maintain an existing marketing program.




The ideal candidate will have the creativity to build the strategy, the technical knowledge to execute it, and the business mindset to connect marketing activity directly to new customer growth and revenue.

title: Senior Engineer, Insights & Reliability Engineering
skills: Build, operate, and evolve reliability tooling, telemetry workflows, alerting systems, dashboards, and automation that help teams detect and investigate customer-impacting issues.
Transform high-volume product, device, payment, partner, and platform telemetry into reliable operational signals for anomaly detection, alerting, debugging, and leadership visibility.
Use SQL, logs, metrics, dashboards, and product context to identify anomalies, baseline performance, validate hypotheses, and uncover patterns that drive reliability improvements.
Lead cross-team improvements to monitoring, alerting, signal quality, triage workflows, and operational automation, defining scalable patterns that reduce time to detection and resolution.

Participate in incident response, alert review, and production issue investigation for device, payment, and partner-related issues, with a focus on improving the systems and processes that make future issues easier to detect and resolve.

Work with internal service owners and external technical partners when reliability issues span device, payment, or partner ecosystems, with a focus on improving the software systems, telemetry, and ownership paths that make future issues easier to detect and resolve.
Collaborate with engineering, product, data, analytics, and partner teams to drive systemic fixes, postmortem learnings, and long-term reliability improvements.
Help set technical direction for reliability tooling and investigation workflows within your area, establishing patterns for telemetry quality, debugging, and operational readiness.
Communicate technical findings, customer impact, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, and/or 8+ years of practical engineering experience.
Strong coding skills, with Python preferred; experience with similar modern programming languages is also welcome if you can ramp up quickly in Python-based workflows.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with high-volume event, telemetry, product, or operational datasets.
Experience building, testing, deploying, and maintaining production-quality software, internal tools, data workflows, automation, or observability systems.
Experience with data-processing systems, analytics engineering workflows, reliability tooling, alerting systems, or operational insight platforms.
Ability to debug ambiguous production problems using data, logs, metrics, dashboards, code, system behavior, and product context.

Experience working across data, observability, and analytics platforms, such as Databricks/Spark for data processing, Airflow/dbt for workflow orchestration and modeling, Datadog/Grafana for monitoring, and Tableau/Mixpanel/Mux for product or experience analytics.
Experience defining scalable operational processes, improving signal quality, reducing alert noise, and turning repeated manual workflows into durable automation.
Experience in reliability engineering, SRE, incident response, support engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, or operational tooling roles.
Comfortable working with consumer device, payment, partner integration, or distributed system domains.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Data, Analytics, and partner-facing teams.
Experience leading ambiguous, cross-system initiatives and aligning multiple teams around technical priorities, operational tradeoffs, and durable reliability improvements.

description:
About the job

About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.

About The Role

The Insights & Reliability Engineering team builds data-intensive software systems that help Crunchyroll proactively detect, investigate, and improve reliability across user-facing experiences, including device QoE, payments, partner integrations, and core product journeys.

As a Senior Engineer, you will build, operate, and evolve tools, telemetry workflows, alerting systems, and operational insight platforms that turn high-volume product and platform data into actionable reliability signals. Your work will help engineering teams identify regressions, understand customer impact, improve signal quality, and drive systemic fixes before issues meaningfully affect users.

This is a software engineering role for someone who enjoys working close to data and production systems. The ideal candidate has strong coding fundamentals, SQL/data fluency, experience building reliable tools or data workflows, and the production instincts to solve ambiguous production problems across systems. As a senior engineer, you will help shape technical direction, define scalable operational practices, and influence cross-functional partners across engineering, product, data, and partner-facing teams.

What You Will Be Doing


Build, operate, and evolve reliability tooling, telemetry workflows, alerting systems, dashboards, and automation that help teams detect and investigate customer-impacting issues.
Transform high-volume product, device, payment, partner, and platform telemetry into reliable operational signals for anomaly detection, alerting, debugging, and leadership visibility.
Use SQL, logs, metrics, dashboards, and product context to identify anomalies, baseline performance, validate hypotheses, and uncover patterns that drive reliability improvements.
Lead cross-team improvements to monitoring, alerting, signal quality, triage workflows, and operational automation, defining scalable patterns that reduce time to detection and resolution.
Participate in incident response, alert review, and production issue investigation for device, payment, and partner-related issues, with a focus on improving the systems and processes that make future issues easier to detect and resolve.
Work with internal service owners and external technical partners when reliability issues span device, payment, or partner ecosystems, with a focus on improving the software systems, telemetry, and ownership paths that make future issues easier to detect and resolve.
Collaborate with engineering, product, data, analytics, and partner teams to drive systemic fixes, postmortem learnings, and long-term reliability improvements.
Help set technical direction for reliability tooling and investigation workflows within your area, establishing patterns for telemetry quality, debugging, and operational readiness.
Communicate technical findings, customer impact, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, and/or 8+ years of practical engineering experience.
Strong coding skills, with Python preferred; experience with similar modern programming languages is also welcome if you can ramp up quickly in Python-based workflows.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with high-volume event, telemetry, product, or operational datasets.
Experience building, testing, deploying, and maintaining production-quality software, internal tools, data workflows, automation, or observability systems.
Experience with data-processing systems, analytics engineering workflows, reliability tooling, alerting systems, or operational insight platforms.
Ability to debug ambiguous production problems using data, logs, metrics, dashboards, code, system behavior, and product context.
Experience working across data, observability, and analytics platforms, such as Databricks/Spark for data processing, Airflow/dbt for workflow orchestration and modeling, Datadog/Grafana for monitoring, and Tableau/Mixpanel/Mux for product or experience analytics.
Experience defining scalable operational processes, improving signal quality, reducing alert noise, and turning repeated manual workflows into durable automation.
Experience in reliability engineering, SRE, incident response, support engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, or operational tooling roles.
Comfortable working with consumer device, payment, partner integration, or distributed system domains.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Data, Analytics, and partner-facing teams.
Experience leading ambiguous, cross-system initiatives and aligning multiple teams around technical priorities, operational tradeoffs, and durable reliability improvements.
Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools, including agentic workflows where appropriate, to accelerate investigation, implementation, testing, or automation, with strong judgment around correctness, maintainability, security, and production safety.
Clear communicator, capable of translating technical findings, reliability risks, and customer impact for broad audiences.


You Might Be a Great Fit If You...


Enjoy building and evolving software, data workflows, and observability systems that make complex production behavior easier to understand and improve.
Are fluent in both code and data, and like using telemetry, SQL, logs, metrics, and product context to solve ambiguous problems.
Are obsessed with understanding root causes, not just patching symptoms.
Believe in turning repeated manual workflows into reliable tools, automation, and scalable operating practices.
Have a strong sense of ownership and pride in improving customer experience through better reliability systems.
Enjoy working behind the scenes to make things “just work” for millions of fans.

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value


Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves. 
Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

description:
About the job

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Merchant Care Analyst I is the foundational tier within our Merchant Care organisation, responsible for delivering efficient and timely responses to merchant inquiries. You will support tickets raised by merchants through any channel, instant messaging, email or web form, as well as requests from internal stakeholders, ensuring queries are addressed promptly and accurately within a specific product scope. The role combines resolving documented issues independently using our established knowledge base with recognising cases of higher complexity and escalating them with clear context to an Analyst II or Senior Analyst. Success in this role means strong communication, a solid understanding of payments, and a genuine sense of urgency in everything you pick up.

What You Will Be Doing


Acknowledge and administer tickets assigned via the ticketing system, remaining logged in and active during working hours.
Investigate and respond to merchant inquiries, as well as requests from internal stakeholders who engage Merchant Care for technical assistance.
Perform initial investigations and refer complex concerns to Analyst II, Senior Analysts, or Level 3 teams as appropriate, providing full context for a speedy resolution.
Resolve tickets using the existing knowledge base, identify documentation gaps, request new SOPs, and keep documentation up to date.
Maintain a solid understanding of our products, services, and policies to provide accurate information to merchants.
Comply with the quality assurance framework to minimise errors and deliver consistent care.
Categorise issues in the global queue and identify repetitive problems, escalating likely root causes to the wider team.
Report procedural problems and participate in feedback loops with our Product and Engineering teams.
Participate actively in training for new products and provide feedback on process gaps to project groups.


About You


2+ years of experience in technical support or operations roles, ideally within Fintech, Banking or Financial Services.
A degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Data or a related field, though equivalent professional experience in other disciplines will be considered.
A comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end payment flow
Strong problem-solving skills, breaking a merchant-reported symptom into checkable components and working through them methodically rather than by trial and error.
Proficient in one or more of the following: API troubleshooting with Postman, log and event analysis with Datadog, data querying with Looker, Snowflake or SQL, and secure environment access tooling such as Guacamole.
Comfortable following SOPs and troubleshooting guides accurately, and knowing which tool applies to which category of task.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to interpret complex technical issues in simple business terms for merchants and non-technical stakeholders.
Able to manage a live workload against SLA countdowns in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high service standards.
Proficiency in using customer service software (e.g. Zendesk, Salesforce) and CRM tools.
Proven ability to work independently as well as collaborate effectively across teams, seeking guidance proactively to ensure positive outcomes for merchants.
A genuine appetite for learning new concepts and technologies quickly, approaching all work with urgency, enthusiasm and a growth mindset.


Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

About the job

About The Role And Team

Working at Uber means solving hard problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. As a CRM Marketing Associate, you will join the Global CRM team to bridge digital and real worlds, powering movement by showing millions of consumers the tangible impact of our products. You will lead the strategy and execution of acquisition campaigns across owned digital channels at a global scale.

This role is not about polished marketing; it's about navigating the messiness of global expansion and program scaling. You will need a "go-get-it" attitude and a mindset built for ownership and adaptability as you move fast to respond to the needs of our growing membership base. If you are energized by the challenge of driving experimentation and reporting results under high-pressure conditions, this is where you'll grow.

What You'll Do


Develop and execute global end-to-end CRM strategies focused on acquisition overall expansion in a high-stakes environment. 
Navigate the complexity of marketing automation tools to build transactional, promotional, and informational content that converts users. 
Scale campaigns across new countries, balancing the need for speed with the messiness of local market requirements. 
Unblock growth by developing learning agendas, moving from experimentation planning to global scaling. 
Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and regional ops teams to identify consumer insights and influence strategy without direct authority. 
Own campaign performance end-to-end, reporting on KPIs and adjusting your approach based on shifting priorities and business needs.

4+ years of experience in customer marketing, customer communications, or the customer engagement space. 
Experience with marketing automation tools and multi-channel campaign management (email, push, in-app). 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. 


Preferred Qualifications 


Proven track record of delivering business results through A/B testing and experimentation at scale. 
Strong systems thinking approach with a fervent interest in how tech stacks empower CRM solutions. 
Ability to thrive in ambiguity and manage multiple stakeholders to remove structural roadblocks. 
Excellent project management skills with a rigorous attention to detail and swift execution. 


Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Global Payments Performance Team identifies payment optimization opportunities for Stripe’s merchants. The Global Payments Performance team serves a critical role both in demonstrating thought leadership on challenging payment topics, and also partnering with our high-potential merchants to set them up for long term success. We want a partnership with Stripe to be a competitive advantage for our customers, large and small, by providing them with best-in-class technology in concert with insightful and specific advice on how to harness this technology to achieve their business goals.

What you’ll do

The Payments Performance Strategist, LatAm, will be responsible for leading data-driven discussions with existing and prospective LatAm merchants on optimisation strategies across a variety of areas including, card network costs, acceptance, fraud, and cross-border flows to start. Initially, the focus will be primarily on the Mexican market. You will be instrumental in building our optimisation narratives/tools and delivering on our merchant engagement model. You will also collaborate with Sales, deploying your knowledge to differentiate Stripe to win deals, and partner with our Customer Success organization to ensure that merchants are successful working with Stripe.

Responsibilities


Lead discussions with existing and prospective LatAm merchants, and provide the Sales team with tools and training to lead discussions with merchants and prospects.
Serve as both an internal and merchant-facing expert on payment optimisation strategies in LatAm.
Gather and build on Stripe’s wide-ranging payments expertise to create LatAm optimisation narratives/tools supported by rigorous analysis.
Use existing tools to deploy sophisticated optimisation playbooks and analyses across Stripe’s LatAm customer portfolio.
Synthesise and relay customer feedback and our findings to inform Stripe’s product roadmap.
Provide feedback on our tools and playbooks to help continuously improve our self serve offerings



Who you are

Minimum Requirements


7+ years of experience in payments or operations at a leading technology company, or consultancy in the payments industry, with a focus on the LatAm market
Understanding of e-commerce payments, cards based payments processing and optimisation strategies
A proven ability to build collaborative working relationships with cross-functional teams.
The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment.
A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision.
Experience presenting directly to merchants
Serve as a subject matter expert providing both internal and customer-facing advisory in the payments domain.
Develop optimization playbooks and stay updated on industry best practices and Stripe innovations
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong data processing, organizational and analytical skills.
Language proficiency in Spanish



Preferred Requirements


Experience with SQL, dashboard building, modeling, or reporting
Understanding of card network rules and regulations, local payment methods, and the regulatory environment (PSD2/PSD3)
Experience presenting to senior business leaders



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet.

We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together. We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About Bridge Operations And The Team

As Stripe's user base and global footprint grow dramatically, especially as crypto and stablecoins fundamentally change the way money is transferred, Stripe acquired Bridge to leverage its stablecoin infrastructure for global payments. Stablecoins facilitate faster, cheaper, and more efficient transactions than traditional methods, which creates unique compliance challenges.

The Bridge Operations strategy provides operational leverage and expands Stripe's portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs in this rapidly evolving space. This role will be part of the KYC and KYB Team within the Risk Ops organization in Bridge Operations that is accountable for performing KYC and KYB reviews during onboarding and periodic review.

What you'll do

We're looking for someone who is passionate about fighting risks and solving the puzzle of investigations, is naturally curious, and is comfortable operating in ambiguity and finding creative solutions. You will be responsible for spearheading the organization's KYC and KYB compliance efforts within the Mexican market.

The right candidate for this role will have experience in KYC and KYB compliance, preferably within the fintech or e-commerce space.

Responsibilities


Conduct thorough Know Your Customer (KYC) reviews during the onboarding of new users, ensuring the authenticity and accuracy of all customer documentation in compliance with Mexico's regulatory requirements.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of KYC, KYB, and anti-money laundering (AML) regulations specific to the Mexico financial services industry, and apply this knowledge to your daily analyses.
Exercise sound judgment to evaluate complex customer information, make informed decisions on the legitimacy of documentation provided, and determine the appropriate risk profile for each customer.
Handle high-complexity KYC and KYB-related assignments and tasks with a sense of urgency, while promptly resolving incoming requests from internal teams, financial partners, and other external parties.
Adhere closely to process documentation and draft clear, concise investigative summaries and analyses, including the preparation of regulatory reports for submission to the relevant authorities.
Actively participate in building a new team and operational culture focused on robust KYC and compliance practices within the organization.
Leverage your expertise in KYC, KYB, and AML to identify and escalate any suspicious customer activity or high-risk profiles to the compliance team for further investigation and action.
Collaborate cross-functionally with teams such as compliance and fraud to share information and insights that contribute to the overall risk management and mitigation efforts within the Mexican market.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Bilingual in English: Excellent conversational, written, and reading skills.
Professional experience: 2+ years of experience in risk or any type of customer-facing roles within a fast-paced environment.
Resilience and adaptability: Proven ability to thrive in evolving environments, remain composed under pressure, and confidently navigate ambiguity.
Structured mindset: A logical, disciplined approach to problem-solving with a relentless focus on accuracy and attention to detail.
Proactive problem-solver: A self-starter capable of working independently to analyze complex data and make sound, defensible investigative decisions.
Process improvement: The ability to identify operational gaps and proactively implement solutions to enhance workflow efficiency.
Effective communication: Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills to clearly articulate findings and recommendations to internal teams and financial partners.
In-office presence: Full availability to work 100% on-site at our office in Reforma, CDMX.



Preferred Qualifications


Startup and tech background: Experience navigating the unique pace and scale of a technology-driven company.
Industry expertise: Deep knowledge of the payments landscape and the fintech industry.
Specialized domain knowledge: A technical background in KYC, KYB, Risk, or Financial Crimes (FC).
Operational agility: Prior experience working within a queue.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

description:
About the job

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is a global company that connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. Our drivers and passengers entrust Lyft with their personal information and travel details to get where they are going and expect us to keep that data safe. Lyft's Privacy team is composed of engineers and analysts dedicated to ensuring appropriate data protections are applied to our drivers' and passengers' data. Our goal is to make privacy the default setting for our internal engineers and our customers. We help design architectures, build a scalable data platform, and define policies to reduce the exposure of user data and ensure appropriate privacy and security protections are applied across the company.

We are looking for a highly motivated, collaborative, team-focused and technically strong Software Engineer to join our Privacy team. As a member of this team, you will design and build systems that make privacy the default at Lyft. Every day, you'll partner with engineering, product, legal, and compliance stakeholders on high-impact projects — from building data redaction pipelines to enabling users to exercise their privacy rights to deploying data management systems across a diverse set of Lyft services. You'll bring strong engineering instincts, a passion for privacy, and the ability to lead large projects from idea to execution.

Responsibilities:

title: VFX & Generative AI Artist
description:
About the job

Buscamos un/a Artista de VFX e IA Generativa para integrarse al equipo interno de CAPONETO. Será un perfil práctico, creativo y resolutivo, capaz de editar contenido audiovisual, realizar composiciones y efectos visuales de complejidad media, corregir color e incorporar herramientas de inteligencia artificial a los procesos de creación y postproducción.




No buscamos necesariamente un especialista senior en efectos visuales, sino una persona versátil, con buen ojo, criterio audiovisual y curiosidad tecnológica, que pueda ejecutar piezas con autonomía y encontrar soluciones eficientes para distintos tipos de proyectos.




Responsabilidades

•⁠ ⁠Editar y terminar piezas audiovisuales para contenido digital, branded content, campañas, presentaciones, cine y televisión.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar compositing, limpieza de imagen, reemplazo de pantallas, integración de fondos, rotoscopia, tracking, chroma key y otros efectos visuales.

•⁠ ⁠Crear, modificar y extender imágenes y videos mediante herramientas de IA generativa.

•⁠ ⁠Desarrollar pruebas visuales, concept videos, animatics, previos y propuestas de estilo.

•⁠ ⁠Integrar material generado con IA dentro de piezas filmadas o editadas de manera tradicional.

•⁠ ⁠Mantener la continuidad visual de personajes, espacios, iluminación, movimiento y estilo en las imágenes generadas.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar corrección de color y looks básicos para unificar y terminar las piezas.

•⁠ ⁠Adaptar contenidos a diferentes duraciones, formatos y relaciones de aspecto.

•⁠ ⁠Preparar versiones y archivos finales conforme a las especificaciones de cada proyecto.

•⁠ ⁠Trabajar en coordinación con productores, directores, editores, diseñadores y el área de postproducción.

•⁠ ⁠Recibir notas creativas y técnicas, interpretarlas y ejecutar los ajustes correspondientes.

•⁠ ⁠Investigar nuevas herramientas y proponer formas concretas de incorporarlas a los procesos de CAPONETO.

•⁠ ⁠Organizar correctamente proyectos, archivos, versiones y materiales de trabajo.




Conocimientos técnicos

•⁠ ⁠Manejo sólido de Adobe Premiere Pro.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimientos intermedios de After Effects para compositing, tracking, rotoscopia, keying y motion graphics.

•⁠ ⁠Manejo de DaVinci Resolve para corrección de color y terminación.

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia con herramientas de generación y edición de video e imagen mediante inteligencia artificial.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para trabajar con prompts, imágenes de referencia, image-to-video, video-to-video, inpainting, outpainting y extensión generativa.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimiento de formatos, códecs, resoluciones, frame rates y espacios de color.

•⁠ ⁠Nociones de flujos de proxies, conformado, exportación y entrega.

•⁠ ⁠Deseable: conocimientos de Photoshop, Illustrator, Blender, Cinema 4D, Nuke o herramientas similares.




Perfil

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia comprobable en edición, postproducción, VFX o creación de contenido audiovisual.

•⁠ ⁠Reel o portafolio que muestre trabajos de edición, compositing, color y/o contenido generado con IA.

•⁠ ⁠Buen ojo para la composición, el ritmo, la iluminación, el color y la integración de imágenes.

•⁠ ⁠Interés genuino por experimentar con nuevas herramientas y procesos.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para resolver problemas técnicos y visuales con los recursos disponibles.

•⁠ ⁠Persona organizada, autónoma, detallista y responsable.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para trabajar en varios proyectos y responder a tiempos de entrega ajustados.

•⁠ ⁠Buena disposición para recibir feedback y trabajar en equipo.

•⁠ ⁠Español fluido e inglés suficiente para utilizar herramientas, investigar procesos y comprender documentación técnica.




Buscamos a alguien que combine sensibilidad audiovisual con habilidad técnica; que disfrute editar, probar, componer y resolver. Alguien que entienda la IA como una herramienta más dentro del proceso creativo y que pueda convertir una idea o referencia en una pieza terminada, coherente y lista para entregar.

skills: Analyze business data to make relevant decisions and build a coherent communication strategy: the right user, the precise message, the opportune moment; to shape behavior and get the pending loan paid.

Bring ambition for the metrics and a 360° business lens. Be able to run a cost-benefit analysis on every notch of the communication strategy you propose (contact cost, channel cost, fatigue cost, risk of the message, expected recovery).
Own the analytical read of what is working and what is not, and kill what is not.

Design and implement the communication strategy from end to end: lifecycle experience design in Figma, copy development, execution in CRM, execution of contact methods outside the CRM (e.g. WhatsApp through the Meta API), communication through the landing page, customer support channels, AI agents, and any other channel that emerges.
Build the channel logic for collections and defend it with results.
Produce the communications for every product development coming out of the squad.
Measure, with structure and clarity, the impact of the communication strategy on the business: default rate, loss rate, and recovery rate.

Keep measurement discipline as the default. Every initiative starts with a dashboard, a metric baseline, an expected uplift calculation, a landed definition of success, and guardrails. No initiative launches without them.
Own the full rollout. Every initiative includes execution and follow-through: correct full rollout, plus attention to any incident or edge case that appears along the way.

Answer "how do we stop this from happening again?" When an error or an edge case appears, the corresponding guardrails get incorporated into the AS IS — and we find out about problems as early as possible, so we get ahead of them instead of reacting to them.

Build the relationships before you need them. Lifecycle management does not work as a series of one-off requests: it depends on standing, close working relationships with Product, Engineering, CX and Data: with agreed SLAs for the things that recur (event instrumentation, data availability, review turnaround, incident response). Part of this role is establishing those agreements and keeping them healthy, so that the next initiative starts from an existing partnership instead of from a negotiation.

Operate as a business unit inside the squad. Work day to day with the product designers, front-end and back-end engineers and data scientists on your team; not as the communication person who receives a finished feature, but as one of the people accountable for the outcome. Every decision has more than one angle (product, risk, data, cost, customer experience), and you are expected to hold all of them.

Make sure every team tells the customer the same story. Align with Customer Support so the message is consistent across every touchpoint. Inconsistency in a collections context costs trust we do not get back.

Bring proposals, not tickets. Communication definitions arrive from this role as proposals to co-create with the squad, not as requests waiting for someone else to fill them. You come with a point of view backed by behavioral evidence, and you change it when the data disagrees.
Desired 5+ years in CRM, lifecycle communications or retention marketing; ideally in fintech, financial services, lending or high-growth B2C.
Proven experience owning communication programs that moved a hard business metric, not only engagement metrics.

HubSpot, Zoho
Claude and AI tooling as daily infrastructure: analysis, copy, workflow

Figma, for lifecycle experience design.

🚀 Buscamos un/a Customer Support Specialist L1 en México para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y estamos armando los equipos que van a llevar estas nuevas líneas de negocio al mercado. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




Buscamos gente con ganas de aprender, actitud resolutiva y vocación de servicio, que entienda que detrás de cada conversación hay un emprendedor confiando en nosotros.




📍 Modalidad híbrida – con esquema de turnos: días presenciales con entrada a las 09:00 y fines de semana remoto.




Tu desafío: Ser la primera línea de soporte vía chat (Intercom) y resolver los problemas de nuestros clientes con rapidez, claridad y empatía. Cada conversación bien resuelta es un cliente que se queda.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Atención en Intercom (tu cancha principal): gestionar tu bandeja de conversaciones, tomar casos y responder en tiempo real.

• Comunicarte con clientes por chat (canal principal) y, ocasionalmente, por mail, teléfono o videollamada.

• Ser el reflejo de la marca en cada mensaje: claro, empático y paciente, sobre todo con clientes poco tecnologizados.

• Resolver consultas de usabilidad guiando al cliente paso a paso dentro de AgendaPro.

• Crear y documentar tickets internos con todo el detalle cuando corresponda.

• Trabajar junto a Tecnología y Producto para que los errores se resuelvan rápido, sin perder nunca el seguimiento con el cliente.

• Cumplir las métricas del área: CSAT, tiempo de primera respuesta (FRT), tiempo de resolución y productividad diaria.

• Participar en capacitaciones, QA y mejora continua de flujos y respuestas.




Requisitos:

• Pasión real por el servicio al cliente: no descansas hasta dejar al usuario con su problema resuelto.

• Excelente comunicación escrita en español: sabes explicar lo complejo de forma simple.

• Habilidad tecnológica básica: navegadores, correo, hojas de cálculo y varias pestañas/herramientas abiertas a la vez sin marearte.

• Comodidad para revisar configuraciones y guiar al cliente en las suyas.

• Proactividad, paciencia, empatía y aguante para manejar varias conversaciones a la vez.

• Disponibilidad para el esquema de turnos (presencial con entrada a las 09:00 y remoto los fines de semana).




Suma puntos (no excluyente):

• Experiencia en atención al cliente, ventas o customer success en empresas de tecnología / SaaS.

• Conocimiento de herramientas tipo Intercom, Zendesk o CRMs.

• Nociones de web, APIs, redes o tecnología en general.

• Inglés intermedio.

title: CRM & Client Operations Administrator
description:
About the job

CRM & Client Operations Administrator

Compensation: $2080 - $2240 USD Per Month!




About Remote Leverage

Remote Leverage is a leading recruiting agency based in Florida, specializing in outsourcing and offshoring talent from Latin America and around the world for U.S.-based businesses. You'll join our team to manage daily CRM workflows to ensure accurate candidate and client documentation.




Responsibilities:

• Review and manage the daily interview schedule and confirmations.

• Track interview times against the correct time zones for both candidates and clients.

• Monitor candidate confirmation status and follow up as needed.

• Immediately update the CRM when a candidate declines an interview, logging the date and a clear explanatory note.

• Maintain an up-to-date view of each client's hiring requirements and current candidates in process.

• Ensure any teammate can open a client profile and immediately understand the status.

• Enter all notes in strict chronological order using a date header followed by bullet points.

• Update candidate profiles promptly upon any status change, including declines and next actions.

• Record the outcome of every scheduled call or interview immediately after it occurs.

• Complete daily and end-of-day CRM quality checklists to ensure all relevant information is logged.




Preferred skills & Tools:

• Experience with a CRM or ATS platform, especially Recruit CRM

• Strong written communication skills for clear and concise note-taking

• Proficiency in Google Workspace and calendar management

• Ability to work across EST time zones for scheduling

• Prior experience in recruiting, staffing, HR operations, or client-facing admin work




Qualifications:

• +1 Years of experience in a CRM & Client Operations Administrator role or related role.

• Fluent in English, both verbal and written.

• Stable internet connection, laptop, and headset.

• High level of motivation and persistence.

• Energetic and upbeat.

• Team player.

• Willing to listen to feedback and improve.




Interested? Hiring immediately. Apply now!

description:
About the job

Job Description

The ideal candidate will possess expertise in NetSuite Financial Management, OneWorld, Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), SuiteBilling, SuiteProjects Pro (PSA), CRM, SuiteAnalytics, SuiteFlow, and the SuiteCloud Platform. Candidates should be able to translate complex business requirements into scalable functional solutions while leveraging NetSuite leading practices.

Strong knowledge of AMP business processes—including advertising campaign management, project-based services, subscription and recurring revenue, resource management, contract and revenue management, multi-entity financial operations, and performance reporting—is essential. Experience integrating NetSuite with CRM, marketing automation, publishing, advertising technology (AdTech), and marketing technology (MarTech) platforms is highly desirable.

Oracle NetSuite's Advanced Customer Support (ACS) organization provides ongoing functional and technical services that help customers maximize the value of their NetSuite investment through continuous optimization, solution enhancements, user adoption, and operational excellence.

As part of the ACS AMP team, this role partners with customers to optimize finance, project operations, revenue management, reporting, integrations, and AI-enabled business processes that improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.

Previous experience within a Fragrance House or the fragrance industry.

About the job

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. description:
About the job

About Us

At WeWork, we provide flexible workspace solutions to help businesses of all sizes thrive in more than 37 countries worldwide. The future of work is here, and we’re not just a part of that movement—we’re leading it. United by a desire to build a global community, our purpose is to give members the support to do their best work, and the space to take their ideas to new heights. Join us as we empower tomorrow’s world at work.

About The Opportunity

Become the Heart of Our Community; Empowering Life's Work

Our Community team isn't just a part of the business—it is the driving force behind our members' success. We are dedicated to enabling every member to create their life's work, and as a Community Lead, you will be leading that effort.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring your building meets our global standards for hospitality and operating excellence. Whether supporting a diverse member base or a key Enterprise client, you will serve as a trusted and reliable leader focused on member satisfaction, operational excellence, and business performance.

Hospitality & Member Engagement

This is an on-site position in WeWork Prolongación 1015 - CDMX, with a requirement to be in the buildings 5 days per week per week. In this role, your work will include but not be limited to the duties listed below: 


Deliver elevated hospitality by anticipating member and guest needs, offering personalized support, and ensuring a positive experience throughout all stages of the member journey.
Act as the primary point of resolution for member feedback, leveraging NPS data to identify trends, solve complex escalations with empathy and accountability, and implement proactive service improvements.
Support the Community Team in execution of a curated community event strategy that fosters professional networking and member connections, directly impacting member retention and satisfaction metrics.
Support the Community desk schedule as needed, ensuring there is consistent coverage during business hours. 


Building Operations


Serve as the on-site Lead owning the operation excellence and standards of your building, identifying and implementing improvements that enhance the space on a daily basis.
Ensure timely resolution, clear communication, and consistent execution on all service requests, monthly move-in/ move-out processes, and maintenance work orders, partnering with internal and external stakeholders. 
Partner with our Security team to be the on-site representative for all safety and security protocols and ensure the building remains compliant with global health and safety standards.
Manage the location’s controllable operating costs, while delivering a premium experience for our members


Revenue Growth And Sales Support


Partner with the Leasing team to lead high-impact tours for prospective members, sharing benefits tailored to their unique business needs to capture new revenue and drive building occupancy.
Drive building financial success by proactively pursuing revenue growth opportunities, such as ancillary service sales and membership upgrades.
Collaborate with members to pinpoint renewal and expansion possibilities through the use of data-informed analytics


About You

We’d love to hear from you if you meet the qualifications below:


Bachelor’s Degree In Hospitality or Tourism
Proficient in English 
Preferred 3+ years of professional experience and proven track record of success in hospitality, multi unit retail or related experience.
A proactive problem-solver with an entrepreneurial mindset who embraces change and is committed to continuous professional growth.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a natural ability to build rapport with diverse stakeholders ranging from entrepreneurs to Enterprise executives.
Experience utilizing data (such as Qualtrics or CRM tools like Salesforce) to inform decision-making and drive member satisfaction.
Embraces challenges in a fast-paced environment. Strategic thinker and problem solver with an entrepreneurial mindset. 
Exhibit a high degree of accountability and a strong work ethic, while maintaining compassion and self-awareness in all professional interactions.


Life at WeWork

Being a WeWorker is more than just a job. We believe the magic of work is sparked by the passion you bring, the places you go, the people you meet and the purpose you follow. And it starts here. Here you will brush shoulders with those who dare to dream and do. Here you will be welcomed by a community that embraces and inspires you—because together we can achieve more. Here we challenge ideas, and explore new ways of getting things done. Whether you are part of our Employee Community Groups, or part of a global project, we ask you to bring your open-minded attitude and collaborative spirit. In return, you will be part of a team where your unique perspectives are celebrated.
